basic_info.description: Tastefully renovated 2 bedroom, 1 bathroom TIC at an incredible value! Steps to vibrant Polk Street shopping, eateries and transportation. Modern kitchen with gas stove, stainless sink, and an  abundance of cabinet and counter space. Gorgeous wood flooring, recessed lights, generous closet space and storage. The well thought out open floor plan with bedrooms on opposite sides makes this unit functional and easy to maintain. Secure direct access to your front door and in-unit washer/dryer checks all the boxes.
